notes.comment: Builds the stock channel pane hierarchy and buttons. Reflow must account for the original named panes and their hit targets.
Draws channel thumbnails using per-channel transforms and visibility. Preserve the association between a thumbnail and its installed title.
Determines whether a channel is in the visible scroll window. Layout reflow must update visibility as well as tile positions.
Selects the channel calculation/loading window. Newly exposed columns need live channel state, not duplicated pictures.
Constructs the channel list for a stock page. Preserve the original channel slot identity and saved ordering.
Begins a stock page scroll. Adaptive columns require a consistent transient page/slot mapping.
Updates shared channel-scene state. Check its ordering against layout calculation and pointer events before installing a hook.

structures.comment: Original stock page index; distinguish it from any experimental presentation page.
